content: अप्रकृत {%a.%} .²1 Not principal or chief, incidental, occasional. .²2 Not relevant to the subject under discussion, not to the point, irrelevant; see प्रकृत, प्रस्तुत; अप्रकृतम् अनुसन्धा ‘to beat about the bush’, not to come to the point. .{@-तम्@} (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) उपमान {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the standard of comparison (<ab>opp.</ab> प्रकृत or उपमेय). .{@-तः@} An insane person (<ab>cf.</ab> Dānasāgara.)
